title: Minimum Subsequence in Non-Increasing Order
summary: Given array nums, find a subsequence with a sum greater than the sum of the remaining elements.
statement: Given array nums, find a subsequence with a sum greater than the sum of the remaining elements. Choose the smallest subsequence by size, and if there are ties, select the one with the highest total sum. Return the subsequence sorted in non-increasing order.
constraints: Return non-increasing values whose sum is strictly greater than the remaining sum.
Use the fewest elements; among ties maximize their sum.
hints: Take values from largest downward to minimize count and maximize sum.
Move each chosen value from the remaining sum to selected sum.
Stop at the first strict selected-greater-than-remaining point.
No equally short selection can exceed the sum of the largest values.
editorial: No equally short selection can exceed the sum of the largest values.

tests.explanation: Ten and nine are the fewest values whose sum exceeds the remainder.
Selecting 7, 7, and 6 gives minimum length and maximum sum.
